question: With reference to the schedule of permissible works notified under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, consider the statements: 1. It lists 375 works, a 41% increase over the earlier 266. 2. Water security is the largest category. 3. Disaster-preparedness works are included as a category for the first time. Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three match the ministry's notification: 375 works, water security 128 (largest), and a new disaster-preparedness category of 38 works.
subject: Polity & Governance

question: In the recent DRDO flight trial of the High-Altitude Platform (HAPS), which of the following is correct?
options: (a) A heavier-than-air UAV from ADE Bengaluru reached 12 km
(b) A lighter-than-air platform developed by ADRDE, Agra reached 21 km AMSL
(c) An ISRO satellite was launched for stratospheric imaging
(d) A HAL-built balloon was tested at Nyoma, Ladakh
explanation: HAPS is a lighter-than-air long-endurance platform by ADRDE, Agra; it reached 21 km AMSL and held 20 km for over 30 minutes.
subject: Science & Technology

question: Which of the following is correct about the recently announced Chief of the Air Staff?
options: (a) Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit is the 29th Chief and takes charge on 31 October 2026
(b) He is currently the Chief of Integrated Defence Staff
(c) He succeeds ACM Amar Preet Singh, who moves to become CDS
(d) He will hold the rank of Air Marshal
explanation: He is currently Vice Chief of the Air Staff, succeeds the retiring ACM Amar Preet Singh on 31 Oct 2026 and holds the rank of Air Chief Marshal.
subject: Internal Security
